display.purpose: Selected pack title; dot-matrix headline. Never body text.

drawer-title.purpose: Activity drawer title and launcher version numerals.

wordmark.purpose: Uppercase Empi Publisher in the topbar.

headline.purpose: Section h2 in Segoe UI Variable.

body.purpose: Everything read or edited; prose capped at 62ch.

code.purpose: Logs, paths, command preview in Cascadia Mono.

shadows.name: drawer-cast
shadows.purpose: The only shadow: separates the slid-in activity drawer from the page.

motion.name: tear
motion.value: 260ms steps(1, end) 1; keyframes 0/15/30/45/60/80/100% translateX -3,4,-2,2,-1px with clip-path inset bands and text-shadow 2px red/cyan split
motion.purpose: Event-only glitch: new step marker, failure banner, pack title after selecting a pack. Replayed by JS tear(el).

motion.name: split
motion.value: 200ms steps(1, end) 1; text-shadow 2px/-2px/1px red and cyan offsets only
motion.purpose: Button hover. No clip-path, no transform.

motion.name: led
motion.value: 1s steps(1, end) infinite; opacity 1 to .2 at 50%
motion.purpose: 10px pink square spinner, the one lit indicator, only while a task runs. Disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: resolve
motion.value: radial-gradient dots on 12px pitch, dot radius = --p x 3.6px, --p 0..1
motion.purpose: Dot-progress strip in the drawer. --p derives from step count (capped at 0.9) until finished; turns coral when failed. Static raster, no animation.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Color and background transitions (.1s to .12s); drawer slide .18s, dialog pop .16s, toast rise .16s.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration and transition-duration .01ms; spinner animation none

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Single column, plates hidden, pipeline compact, sidebar becomes a horizontal strip.

tokens.name: dotted
tokens.purpose: The dotted rule used for topbar, subtabs, pipeline, section dividers.

tokens.name: pipeline-h
tokens.value: 84px (set at runtime from the measured footer height)
tokens.purpose: Reserves bottom space and positions the toast and bottom-left plate.

tokens.name: plates
tokens.value: art/field.png at 340px, opacity .6 (bottom-left) and .5 rotated 180deg (top-right 320x118), masked to feather
tokens.purpose: Static halftone ground; hidden at 900px and below.

assets.name: art
assets.purpose: Procedural halftone rasters from tools/publisher/scripts/make-art.js; provenance embedded in PNG tEXt chunks by impeccable embed-prompt.

components.name: Primary Button (Compilar)

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 14px/1.5 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; background: #18181c; color: #f1efe8; border: 1px solid #3b3b44; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary { background: #ff3d8b; color: #16030c; border-color: #ff3d8b; font-weight: 700; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 9px) 0, 100% 9px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-primary:hover { background: #ff6aa6; border-color: #ff6aa6; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { clip-path: none; outline: 2px solid #ff3d8b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default action. Hover flashes a red/cyan text split.

components.name: Paper Button
components.description: Inverted emphasis without pink: Nuevo, Guardar, Crear.

components.name: Disabled Button (stipple)

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed well field; the focus ring is pink and drawn inside.

components.description: Current tab is paper text over a 4px strip of pink dots.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; background: #111114; height: 52px; } .ds-tab { position: relative; background: none; border: 0; color: #a5a598; padding: 0 14px; font: 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab[aria-current] { color: #f1efe8; } .ds-tab[aria-current]::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: 0; height: 4px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #ff3d8b 1px, transparent 1.5px) 0 50% / 6px 4px repeat-x; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3d8b; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.description: Dot-progress strip whose dot radius scales with --p (0 to 1) plus the 10px pink LED spinner.
components.css: @keyframes ds-led { 50% { opacity: .2; } } .ds-led-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #f1efe8; font: 700 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-led { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: #ff3d8b; animation: ds-led 1s steps(1, end) infinite; } .ds-resolve { height: 14px; width: 320px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #f1efe8 calc(var(--p) * 3.6px), transparent calc(var(--p) * 3.6px + .6px)) 0 50% / 12px 14px repeat-x; }

narrative.overview:
A darkroom bench where a modpack is framed, developed and printed. Ground is near-black, marks are paper-white, and tone is made of halftone dots rather than gradients or shadows. The tool is still at rest: a glitch (a 260 ms scan-line tear with a red/cyan channel split) is how it speaks about change and failure, and one electric pink is reserved for the next thing the operator should do. Text and controls stay crisp and legible; the dithering, ribbing and glitch belong to the ground and to events, never to the words you work in.

The mood is precise, printed and slightly uncanny: dot-matrix headlines over a plain Windows UI face, square corners, dotted rules where other systems draw solid lines, and static halftone plates (flower, cloud, tear, field) as the only imagery. Density is that of a working tool: a 290px pack list beside a form column, with a fixed pipeline footer that always shows the current step. Low RAM and CPU are a product principle, so every texture is a pre-rendered raster or CSS gradient on a fixed layer and nothing loops except one LED while a task runs.
keyCharacteristics: Black and paper-white plus exactly one pink; pink means "next action" or "focus".
Dotted rules (radial-gradient dots) divide sections, tabs, the topbar and the pipeline instead of solid hairlines.
Square corners everywhere; the primary button is notched, not rounded.
Doto dot-matrix for identity and numerals only; Segoe UI Variable for everything read or edited.
Motion is event-only: tear on new step, failure and pack selection; split on button hover.
Halftone plates are static, feathered by masks, height-capped and hidden at 900px and below.

rules.name: The One Pink Rule
rules.body: Pink marks the next action and focus, nothing else. A second pink element competing on screen means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Flash-Only Channels Rule
rules.body: Red and cyan appear only as 260 ms (or 200 ms hover) split flashes. They are never persistent.

rules.name: The Status Exception Rule
rules.body: danger and warn are the only persistent colors outside black, white and pink, and only for status. Do not extend them to decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The Dots Are Headlines Rule
rules.body: Doto is for the wordmark, headlines, the drawer title and version numerals. It is never body text, labels, buttons or inputs.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Counts, sizes, versions and progress use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: No hard offset shadows, glows or blurred card shadows. The drawer cast is the only shadow.

rules.name: The Ribbed Glass Exception
rules.body: The topbar's repeating-linear-gradient of fine vertical paper lines is a deliberate part of the world (ribbed glass from the moodboard). It is an intentional advisory exception, not a defect: do not remove it, and do not spread it beyond the topbar.

rules.name: The Static Raster Rule
rules.body: Every texture is a pre-rendered PNG or a CSS gradient on a fixed layer. No canvas, video, blur filters or continuously animated background.

dos: Do spend pink only on the next pipeline action, the focus ring, active-tab dots, the dashed current-step marker, the running LED and the logo dot.
Do invert to paper (#f1efe8 on #0b0b0d) for selection and secondary emphasis: active pack card, selected version choice, Nuevo, Guardar, Crear.
Do divide with the dotted rule (--dotted, or dot-coloured dotted borders) instead of solid hairlines.
Do fire tear only on events (new step marker, failure banner, pack title after selecting a pack) and use the split text-shadow only for hover.
Do keep art static: body::before and body::after plates from art/field.png feathered with a mask and height-capped; cloud in the drawer head, tear behind error banners, flower in the empty state.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion and keep raster layers fixed; minimum RAM and CPU is a hard product principle.
Do keep persistent danger and warn for status only (Libre badges, error banners, Cancelar outline, failed step). They are legibility exceptions to the black/white/pink palette.
donts: Don't add a second accent, gradient fills on controls or colored glows.
Don't show red or cyan at rest; they exist only inside the 260 ms tear and 200 ms split flashes.
Don't set Doto on body text, labels, buttons or inputs.
Don't round corners or add card shadows or hard offset shadows.
Don't animate hover with transform or clip-path; hover uses only text-shadow (split) and color transitions.
Don't add continuously animated backgrounds, blur filters, video or canvas. The only looping motion is the running-task LED (plus the short-lived loading skeleton).
Don't remove the topbar's ribbed-glass repeating gradient as a defect; it is a deliberate advisory exception. Don't reuse it as a general pattern either.
Don't let a halftone plate end in a hard edge or sit at full strength behind list text.
Don't use danger or warn for decoration or emphasis; they are for status only.
